envelope.description: JetBrains client: gateway, DTO, settings page and fixtures

body.title: JetBrains client: gateway, DTO, settings page and fixtures
body.summary: Add readRepoSettings and writeRepoSetting to DaemonGateway, DaemonGatewayImpl and DaemonGatewayService, repoFields with an emptyList default to SettingsCatalogDto and parseCatalog, the RepoSettingsResult type, the pooled-thread load in InsrcSettingsConfigurable and the tracker rows in PerRepoSection, and update the four DaemonGateway test doubles and the five settings tests. If the Kotlin tests cannot be run in the build environment, the build notes say so.
acceptanceChecks: The five settings tests compile and pass unchanged and the four doubles implement the new methods

The page loads repoFields and each repo's settings on the pooled thread, shows a per-repo error without breaking the other repos, and routes tracker edits to writeRepoSetting while model-tier edits keep writeSetting
The sign-in row is read-only and shows the status and reason for signed-in and each failure state

tests.name: jetbrains-plugin InsrcSettingsTrackerTest: parseCatalog keeps repoFields, the page loads them on a pooled thread and edits route to writeRepoSetting
jetbrains-plugin SettingsCatalogDtoDefaultTest: the DTO defaults repoFields and the five settings tests pass unchanged
jetbrains-plugin DaemonGatewayServiceTest: forwards readRepoSettings and writeRepoSetting and the four doubles compile
jetbrains-plugin PerRepoSectionTest: one repo's failure shows its reason and the others still render
jetbrains-plugin PerRepoSectionTest: the sign-in row is read-only for signed-in and every failure state
